theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_leibniz_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn U m) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → ∃ (η₁ : TestFormOn U m) (η₂ : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), (∀ x, (η₁ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x = ψ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∧ (∀ x, (η₂ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = ψ x • exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal |T.boundary η₁ - T η₂| ≤ ∫⁻ x, (‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)) ∂μ
